## Summary
- Add optional `AGENT_INSTALL_PAT` plumbing through the entrypoint, label, and router workflows.
- Block `/install owner/repo` before the skill runs when `AGENT_INSTALL_PAT` is missing, with a clear required-secret and rerun message.
- Pass `AGENT_INSTALL_PAT` as the install-agent task token only for the `install` route; normal skill and other routes keep the existing auth resolver path.
- Update install docs, setup/configuration docs, install skill guidance, and envelope tests.

## Notes
- This does not add `AGENT_INSTALL_POLICY`, fork creation, or a typed cross-repo PR helper.

## Verification
- `npm --prefix .agent run build`
- `node --test .agent/dist/__tests__/envelope.test.js .agent/dist/__tests__/resolve-dispatch-cli.test.js .agent/dist/__tests__/triage.test.js`
- `node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const YAML=require('yaml'); for (const f of ['.github/workflows/agent-router.yml','.github/workflows/agent-entrypoint.yml','.github/workflows/agent-label.yml']) YAML.parse(fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'));"`
- `git diff --check`

Closes #282

## Summary of PR/Issue
PR #283 is the second focused child under #277, building on #281’s first-class `/install` route. It adds `AGENT_INSTALL_PAT` as the install-only machine-user token, blocks `/install owner/repo` when that secret is absent, and leaves normal routes on the existing GitHub auth resolver. The PR intentionally does not add `AGENT_INSTALL_POLICY`, fork creation, or a typed cross-repo PR helper. Docs, skill guidance, and envelope tests were updated for the new secret and blocked-state behavior.

## Review
The current reviewer artifacts and PR diff support shipping this PR. Both reviewers found no blocking or warning-level issues, and there is no meaningful reviewer disagreement.
